title: Kotlin App Engineer (Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile App Development)
summary: This freelance/contract position focuses on mobile app feature development and Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) common platform development. The role includes leading the migration to KMP and acting as a tech lead.
content:
This freelance/contract position focuses on mobile app feature development and Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) common platform development. The role includes leading the migration to KMP and acting as a tech lead.

  • Focus: Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) design and development for mobile apps, alongside feature improvements.
  • Role: Tech-lead level, responsible for migration and common platform development.
  • Requirements: 3+ years of Android app development with Kotlin, experience in requirement definition, design, implementation, code review, and team development with Git/Pull Requests.
  • Preferences: Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP).
  • Contract Details: Freelance/contract position (65-75万 JPY/month), partial remote possible.
  • Status: The page indicates the listing is '募集終了' (recruitment closed).
  • Visa Sponsorship: Not applicable for freelance contract.
